notes.title: Dev Update: Almost There! Breeze of Passion DLC Progress!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/a537b55c1e1c971a3f929544f109998e0e48e4de.jpg[/img]

Hello there, everyone!

Today, we have several exciting updates about the Breeze of Passion DLC for you.

As we mentioned earlier, this expansion promises to be big and packed with content. The story will revolve around a hotel inspection that, of course, quickly spirals out of control. You'll have to act fast and think outside the box to save the hotel and not let the beloved Emma down. The inspector will turn out to be a real challenge — cold, bold, and sharp-tongued. But we believe this task is well within your power — after all, you know exactly how to win over even the most unapproachable ladies.

Every decision you make will matter. To save the hotel, you might need to resort to different methods: spying, blackmail, or seduction — the choice is yours.

As always, loyal and stunning beauties will be by your side, ready to help. But don’t forget — even their help comes at a price, and how you’ll pay for it is up to you.

And, of course, in the best traditions of our games, you’ll be treated to steamy scenes with your favorite MILFs, as well as fiery encounters with new and equally breathtaking ones.

Now a bit about development. Right now, we’re in the final stage. A huge amount of animations, scenes, and mocap videos have been created and are currently undergoing meticulous polishing: artworks are being refined, animations improved, sound effects added, and visual details perfected. As soon as we complete the visual part, we'll move on to coding and thorough bug testing to ensure you can enjoy the game without anything distracting you.

And here’s more great news. Now that most of the material is ready, we’re starting to treat you to fresh spoilers! The first one is already featured as the cover image for this post. In the coming days, we’ll be posting more sneak peeks to let you feel the atmosphere of the upcoming update we’ve been working so hard on.

The wait is almost over — just one final push remains, and very soon,  you’ll be able to fully enjoy all this magnificent content!

We are deeply grateful for your patience, support, and trust in the project. Thanks to you, Breeze of Passion is becoming exactly what we envisioned — vivid, rich, and unforgettable.

Stay with us — and thank you for being such an amazing community! 🔥
With love, from all of our development team!

notes.title: First DLC COMING SOON!!!
notes.content:
Hello there, everyone!

We’re incredibly grateful for your amazing support and love for our projects. Thanks to you, we get to keep doing what we love — and we’re giving it everything we’ve got.

Many of you have been asking when there’ll be news about the long-promised DLC for Breeze of Passion. Well, the wait is over — the time has come! The next update we’re releasing will be this highly anticipated DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/f0d4e982e225516388f45f71f6330ce069ce2f1c.jpg[/img]

To be honest, we started working on the script quite a while ago, but we were also busy developing the massive updates for MILFs of Sunville. We’re sure you remember just how huge that last update was — and that’s exactly why progress on the DLC wasn’t as fast as we’d hoped.

But now we can confidently say: you’re in for another huge event. We’ve listened to your feedback and kept in mind everything you love — from the classy MILFs to the bold babes like Cathy and the sweethearts like Summer. This DLC will have something for everyone — rich, spicy, and, as always, very explicit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/4cc587c234f66b2430f35a2306298486e32bff88.jpg[/img]

A heads-up: the DLC is going to be big. Because of the amount of content we’re packing in, the production timeline will be a bit longer. Our artists and animator are already hard at work, crafting stunning new artwork featuring your favorite girls.

And here’s a little spoiler — the whole DLC will play out as one major event. You’ll need to flex your skills both as a businessman and a seducer. We promise: it’s going to be hot. Very hot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145898/679366b0dbbeb9d390c9b8176b324eb328141c41.jpg[/img]

Once Breeze of Passion DLC is released, we’ll immediately jump into the next massive update for MILFs of Sunville — and it’s going to be just as intense and packed with content.

Stay tuned, and stick with us — you won’t want to miss this!

We are happy to present you the final update for [b]Breeze of Passion[/b]!

Although the story of [b]Breeze of Passion[/b] has come to an end, many players requested we continue with it and their desire to see more.

That's why we plan to release additional content for the game some time in the future.

In the meantime, you can enjoy this amazing update with the final part of a fun story filled with passion and emotions!

We're immensely grateful for your support!

It's only thanks to it that the characters of our games can come to life in our world.

By supporting us, you become a part of all the events surrounding our favorite characters.

notes.title: Breeze of Passion v6 : Spoiler 1

Hello to all the high-quality content lovers out there—get ready for the event you've been eagerly waiting for because our new release is just around the corner! The story keeps moving forward! In this update, you can expect [b]6 fantastic[/b] scenes that set the stage for new developments, whether it's interactions with new ladies or business advancements.

Our main character continues his ascent to the top, displaying his unmatched talent and business acumen. But, as often happens in the ruthless world of business, competition and intrigue are part of the game. For those who admire strong women, this clash with the formidable lady is an encounter you can't miss. The question remains: who will get on top of?

But don’t worry, for those who long for the company of gentle and affectionate women, we’ve got something special too. We invite you to immerse yourself in a scene filled with passion and tenderness featuring the lovely Stephanie. This darling shines in any situation, whether she’s in a banana suit or without it.
